criteria.description: PATCH /api/users/me without a valid JWT token returns HTTP 401.
criteria.evidence: userProfile.test.ts > PATCH /api/users/me > requires a valid JWT — PASSED ✓ 2ms. Vitest run: 44/44 tests passed. Test sends PATCH /api/users/me with no Authorization header and asserts res.status === 401. Confirmed by stderr output showing AuthError: Unauthorized with statusCode: 401.

criteria.description: PATCH /api/users/me with a valid JWT and a body containing at least one recognised field returns HTTP 200 with body { user: { id, email, username, createdAt } } where user.username is the updated value, user.email is unchanged, and user.password is absent (undefined).
criteria.evidence: userProfile.test.ts > PATCH /api/users/me > updates the username and returns the new user object — PASSED ✓ 4ms. Asserts res.status === 200, res.body.user.username === 'after_username_change', res.body.user.email === user.email, res.body.user.password toBeUndefined. Vitest: 44/44 tests passed.

criteria.description: PATCH /api/users/me with an empty body {} or a body containing only unrecognised fields returns HTTP 400.
criteria.evidence: userProfile.test.ts > PATCH /api/users/me > returns 400 for an empty body / no recognised fields — PASSED ✓ 4ms. Test sends {} with valid JWT and asserts res.status === 400. Confirmed by stderr: ValidationError with statusCode: 400. Vitest: 44/44 tests passed.

criteria.description: PATCH /api/users/me with newPassword present but currentPassword absent returns HTTP 400.
criteria.evidence: userProfile.test.ts > PATCH /api/users/me > returns 400 when newPassword is given without currentPassword — PASSED ✓ 4ms. Test sends { newPassword: 'brandnewpassword1' } with valid JWT and asserts res.status === 400. Confirmed by stderr: ValidationError with statusCode: 400. Vitest: 44/44 tests passed.

criteria.description: PATCH /api/users/me with both newPassword and currentPassword present, but currentPassword wrong, returns HTTP 400 with JSON body { "error": "Current password is incorrect" }.
criteria.evidence: userProfile.test.ts > PATCH /api/users/me > returns 400 'Current password is incorrect' when currentPassword is wrong — PASSED ✓ 4ms. Test sends { currentPassword: 'not-the-real-password', newPassword: 'brandnewpassword1' }, asserts res.status === 400 and res.body.error === 'Current password is incorrect'. Confirmed by stderr: ValidationError: Current password is incorrect, statusCode: 400. Vitest: 44/44 tests passed.

criteria.description: PATCH /api/users/me with correct currentPassword and newPassword stores new password as bcrypt hash (matching /^\$2[aby]?\$/) in the users table; a subsequent POST /api/auth/login with the new password returns 200 and with the old password returns 401.
criteria.evidence: Two tests both PASSED: (1) 'updates the password so a subsequent login with the new password succeeds and the old one fails' ✓ 8ms — asserts patchRes.status === 200, oldLogin.status === 401, newLogin.status === 200. (2) 'stores the updated password as a bcrypt hash, not plaintext' ✓ 5ms — queries db directly via db.prepare('SELECT password FROM users WHERE email = ?').get(email), asserts row.password matches /^\$2[aby]?\$/ and row.password !== 'the-new-password2'. Vitest: 44/44 tests passed.

criteria.description: PATCH /api/users/me where the requested email is already owned by a different user returns HTTP 409, and neither the username nor any other field of the requesting user is modified in the database.
criteria.evidence: userProfile.test.ts > PATCH /api/users/me > returns 409 for an email already taken by another user, and leaves no field changed — PASSED ✓ 7ms. Sends { username: 'renamed_before_conflict', email: taken.email }, asserts res.status === 409, then GET /api/auth/me confirms me.body.username === 'wants_taken_email_user' and me.body.email === 'wants-taken-email@example.com' (both original values, unmodified). Confirmed by stderr: ConflictError: Email already taken, statusCode: 409. Vitest: 44/44 tests passed.

criteria.description: PATCH /api/users/me where the requested username is already owned by a different user returns HTTP 409.
criteria.evidence: userProfile.test.ts > PATCH /api/users/me > returns 409 for a username already taken by another user — PASSED ✓ 4ms. Sends { username: taken.username } and asserts res.status === 409. Confirmed by stderr: ConflictError: Username already taken, statusCode: 409. Vitest: 44/44 tests passed.

criteria.description: GET /api/auth/me resolves the user exclusively from the JWT payload (req.user.userId) and ignores any id or userId query parameters in the URL; it always returns the token owner's own data.
criteria.evidence: userProfile.test.ts > GET /api/auth/me — ownership > returns only the caller's own data regardless of a spoofed id in the URL — PASSED ✓ 21ms. Calls GET /api/auth/me?id=${other.id}&userId=${other.id} with mine.token, asserts res.status === 200, res.body.id === mine.id, res.body.email === mine.email, res.body.username === mine.username. Vitest: 44/44 tests passed.

criteria.description: The user router is mounted in src/app.ts at the prefix /api/users so that PATCH /api/users/me reaches the route handler (not a 404).
criteria.evidence: Structural check: grep on src/app.ts found line 7 'import userRoutes from ./routes/userRoutes' and line 28 'app.use('/api/users', userRoutes)'. All 9 PATCH /api/users/me tests in userProfile.test.ts returned non-404 status codes (401, 200, 400, 409). Build succeeded (tsc -p tsconfig.build.json, exit 0, no errors). Vitest: 44/44 tests passed.

criteria.description: The password field is never present in any successful API response (neither from PATCH /api/users/me nor from GET /api/auth/me).
criteria.evidence: userProfile.test.ts > 'updates the username and returns the new user object' asserts res.body.user.password toBeUndefined — PASSED ✓. auth.test.ts > 'returns the user object for a valid token, without the password field' — PASSED ✓. No other test in either suite expects a password key in a success response body. Vitest: 44/44 tests passed.

criteria.description: The update performed by PATCH /api/users/me is atomic — if email uniqueness or username uniqueness validation fails after other fields have been checked, no fields are written to the database.
criteria.evidence: userProfile.test.ts > 'returns 409 for an email already taken by another user, and leaves no field changed' — PASSED ✓ 7ms. Request body included { username: 'renamed_before_conflict', email: taken.email }. After 409 response, GET /api/auth/me confirmed username is still original 'wants_taken_email_user' (the rename was NOT applied), proving atomicity — no partial write occurred. Vitest: 44/44 tests passed.
